name: erp
description: Inauviet ERP: quotes, orders, design, production, delivery and payments

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.api:types: npm run openapi -w api && npm run api:types -w web
scripts.test: npm test -w api && npm test -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
